messages.subject: flexible model fitting problem
parts:
Hi everybody,

I'm trying to follow the example at http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_smooth.html
to do some flexible model fitting to some data I have. (I want to fit
a slightly more complicated mode than the default done by
geom_smooth.) However, unlike the example on the web page the
variables in the model I want to fit are not factors they're a range
of integer values.

When I use the code (similar to the code at the webpage above) in
graph example 2 in the code below, I get a saw tooth like pattern.
When I use the code in graph example 1 I get a straight line but the
shaded interval region is in many cases so narrow as to be invisible
which doesn't make sense to me. Can any one point out to me what I've
done wrong?

Thanks in advance,

Colm.

rm(list=ls())
graphics.off()

library(gdata)
library(reshape)
library(ggplot2)

predictionSequenceLength=10

"b" = c("c", "p")

)))

grid$value = predict(model, newdata=grid)
err <- predict(model, newdata=grid, se = TRUE)
grid$ucl <- err$fit + 1.96 * err$se.fit
grid$lcl <- err$fit - 1.96 * err$se.fit

## graph example 1
## yields a straight line but the SE is in many cases so narrow as

aes(x=eval(parse(text=e)), y=value, color=t, shape=t)) +

color="black") +
labs(x=eval(gsub(".", " ", e, fixed=T)), y="Volume") +
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

quartz()
print(graph)

## graph example 2
## yields staircase line plots
graph2=ggplot(melted.d[melted.d$cl %in% level, ],
aes(x=eval(parse(text=e)), y=value)) +
geom_point(data=melted.d[melted.d$cl %in% level, ],
aes(x=eval(parse(text=e)), y=value, color=t, shape=t)) +
geom_smooth(aes(ymin=lcl, ymax=ucl), data=grid, color="black",
stat="identity") +
labs(x=eval(gsub(".", " ", e, fixed=T)), y="Volume") +
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

quartz()
print(graph2)
}

messages.subject: Re: flexible model fitting problem
parts:
Hi Colm,

I'm not sure exactly what you're looking for, but this is how I'd do it:

# Use ddply to create all the models/data at once
library(plyr)
library(MASS)
mods <- dlply(melted.d, "cl", function(df) {
rlm(value ~ c + p, data = df)
})

n <- 10
grid <- with(d, expand.grid(
c = seq(min(c), max(c), length = n),
p = seq(min(p), max(p), length = n)
))

preds <- ldply(mods, function(model) {
grid$value <- predict(model, newdata=grid)

err <- predict(model, newdata=grid, se = TRUE)
grid$ucl <- err$fit + 1.96 * err$se.fit
grid$lcl <- err$fit - 1.96 * err$se.fit

grid
})


ggplot(melted.d, aes(p, value)) +
geom_point(aes(colour = t, shape = t)) +
geom_smooth(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = lcl), data = preds, colour = "grey30") +
facet_wrap(~ cl) +
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")


Hadley
